privacy.purpose: Historical catalog/price interpretation and authorized future projections
privacy.access: Tenant-scoped workloads authorized by capability; no browser broker access
privacy.retention: Versioned domain profiles ADR-016/035; no new legal period. Outbox/inbox operational retention is not business-history retention.
privacy.audit_actor: Restricted local audit only, linked by causation_id; not event payload
privacy.base: Authorized organization operations and historical interpretation; no marketing reuse
privacy.log_policy: Do not log event bodies or field values; minimize correlation metadata
privacy.encryption: TLS in transit and encryption at rest by owner/workload policy before runtime
privacy.history_retention: Approve versioned owner historical policy before F1-08; legal holds and inherited obligations apply. Never use transport TTL as business retention.
privacy.export_correction: Authorized organization data export; correction creates a new version, never rewrites retained facts
privacy.third_parties_regions: No transfers or region deployment authorized by this candidate

future_runtime.atomicity: Domain fact/history + mandatory audit + serialized outbox in one owner SQL transaction
future_runtime.reconstruction: Approve durable owner historical source and authorized export/replay with stable IDs/checkpoints before F1-08 producer; never outbox alone
